collisionGeometry.kind: read-only arithmetic from recorded checkpoint coordinates and literal original collision constants; not game execution

findings: F was processed: actual threat.attack parent and nested advance10, UI64HP at09:23 to50HP09:33.
First retreat begins only10:01 HP14, about32.7 seconds after F returns; unpaused world time and real damage continue during sampling/thinking.

Five retreat keys happen before recorded loss, with positive publicHP, no start overlay and no visible modal-close/select controls. Focus and exact live modal/session flags were not captured, so no absolute focus claim.

Original collision rule rejects recorded north/west one-step candidates against frontier1. Matching nearby enemy coordinates at10:00 and10:10 support physical obstruction, rather than requiring a focus bug explanation.
Movement dispatch is ephemeral; absent persisted movement commands is not evidence keydown was ignored. Command watermark gaps are consistent with those ephemeral attempts.

Clicking the nearby broadcast landmark actually ran discovery+advance20 despite being labelled select/read; no minutes property meant the runner safety precheck did not run before that paid operation.
No product input bug is established from this evidence. No movement replay result or unrecorded focus fact is invented.
bDecision: Do not treat the same timed key sequence as safe for B. Canonical input acceptance establishes loading only. B needs current public risk/HP and paid-action time checks, little idle analysis while unpaused, and actual displacement feedback. Collision no-move should stop/replan from public scene instead of repeating north/west. East/south arithmetic clears this one recorded enemy only; it is not a validated safe route or permission to start B blindly.
